title: Mecca and Macoraba (Al-ʿUṣūr al-Wusṭā 26)
description: Survey of the documentary history behind the Macoraba–Mecca identification; concludes there is no secure evidence for Mecca's antiquity in the pre-Islamic record and that the Macoraba equation rests on assumption rather than evidence.

cited_by.title: The First Mosques Faced Petra, Not Mecca
